sessions.name: A
prompts: Decision for this project: every date fieldnotes prints must be ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD...). Never use locale formats like 'Jan 2' or '02/01/2026'. Please look at how `list` prints dates and confirm it follows this.

sessions.name: B
prompts: Add an `export` command to fieldnotes that prints one line per note as `DATE: TEXT`, with a unit test. Run the project checks.

exact_observations: The user declared ISO-8601 dates for all printed output.

supported_lessons.proposition: All dates printed by fieldnotes use ISO-8601; locale formats are not allowed.

prohibited_generalizations: Every project must use ISO-8601 dates.
